_readme: Which LED panel the clock tools talk to. Change 'name' to point them at a
different panel -- that is the BLE advertised name, the one a scan shows,
and the only field used to connect. 'address' and 'note' are for reference.
JSON has no comments, so anything worth writing down goes in 'note'.
Overrides, highest first: --name on the command line, the LED_BLE_NAME
Run 'py device_settings.py' to see what this file currently resolves to.
Geometry is still fixed at 32x16 in code; this file only picks the device.

clock.name: LED_BLE_CD9B89CA
clock.note: the 32x16 panel every script in this repo was proven on
